annotations.title: Trending topics in high-importance news with change vs. the previous window

description:
Trending topics in high-importance news with change vs. the previous window. Top 5 topics (hashtags, names, keywords; counted once per item) in high-importance news of the last N hours (1-72, default 6), each with prev_count in the previous equal-length window, change = count - prev_count, and latest_id/latest_source_url

GET /news/topics/trending — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-72) Default: 6.
